name: scss-template
description: Modern SCSS template for HTML/CSS projects

scripts.build:html: html-minifier-terser --collapse-whitespace --remove-comments src/index.html -o dist/index.html && html-minifier-terser --collapse-whitespace --remove-comments src/components.html -o dist/components.html
scripts.build: npm run clean && npm run copy:assets && npm run build:scss && npm run build:js && npm run build:html
